simple.summary: מֶשֶׁךְ (meshek) means a sowing ; also a possession First listed occurrence: Job 28 18.

definitions.full: H4901. meshek I. [ מֶ֫שֶׁךְ ] noun [masculine] a drawing, drawing up, a trail ; — 1 construct מִמְּנִינִים חָכְמָה מֶשֶׁךְ Job 28:18 the drawing up (fishing up, i.e. securing after effort) of wisdom is beyond corals. 2 construct a trail (of seed), ׳מֶ הַזָּ֑רַע Psa 126:6 bearing the trail of seed; compare מָשַׁךְ 6
